topic: PLAN screen (§6.4) swap-deck commit has no AppState slice to write into
detail: PLAN §6.4's swap deck must let a committed swap 're-label the slot (`swap` tag) and recompute the day's ladders + shopping deltas', and PHASE2-CONTRACT.md says those 'shopping deltas are consumed by SHOP later via the store'. I audited src/state/** end to end before touching anything: AppState (src/state/types.ts) has exactly 8 slices — prefs, inventory, eaten, shopTicks, leftovers, waste, priceChecks, timers — each one enumerated explicitly in FOUR separate places (the AppState interface + defaultState in reducer.ts, SLICE_KEYS in store.tsx, SLICE_SCHEMAS/AppStateSchema in schemas.ts, and hydrateAll in persist.ts). There is no `swaps` slice and no generic/open extension point — no catch-all action type, no free-form bag field — that a screen could hook into without editing state/** directly. My task brief's ownership rules forbid editing src/state/**, and the brief's own standing instruction for exactly this case reads: 'if genuinely absent, implement the screen against a minimal swaps action you add ONLY if the reducer already has an extension point you can use without editing state/** — otherwise STOP and file a decision-request.' There is no such extension point, so this file is that decision-request rather than a silent workaround.
whatIBuiltInstead: src/screens/plan/** is fully built and functional per §6.4, including a complete swap-deck interaction: candidates ranked by coverageForMeal (src/state/selectors.ts, unmodified), plain ◂ ▸ steppers, a live Δkcal/Δprotein band-impact preview computed before committing, and a commit/cancel flow. Swap commits are held in a session-only, module-level store local to src/screens/plan/swapStore.ts (a plain ES-module singleton — useSyncExternalStore, no React Context, no localStorage) so the whole interaction is demonstrable end-to-end within one browser session: the grid re-labels the slot 'swap', the day's macro line updates, the roll-up and the hero gauge recompute. This is explicitly NOT the real thing and is called out as such in the UI itself (a small note under the swap-deck's commit button) and in code comments at the top of swapStore.ts: state resets on page reload, and — the part that actually matters — it is invisible to every other screen, so SHOP cannot later read these swaps to compute shopping deltas as PHASE2-CONTRACT requires. This must be replaced once the decision below is resolved; the shim's two call sites (commitSwap/useSwaps) are isolated and commented for a fast swap-out.
options: A. Add a `swaps` AppState slice: `swaps: Record<string, string>` keyed "<week>:<day>:<slot>" (e.g. "A:2:dinner") -> replacement mealId, plus actions `swaps/set {week,day,slot,mealId}` and `swaps/clear {week,day,slot}`. Additive to AppState/defaultState/reducer.ts/SLICE_KEYS/schemas.ts (a SwapsSchema = z.record(z.string(), z.string()))/hydrateAll — backward compatible, since hydrateSlice's missing-key fallback already returns {} cleanly for state persisted before this slice existed. (recommended)

B. Model a swap as an override on an existing slice instead of adding a new one — not recommended: none of the 8 existing slices are a semantically honest home for 'which meal is currently shown in this planned slot' (eaten is a log of what already happened; the rest are unrelated domains), and it still requires editing state/** either way, just less legibly.
